text: (1) to (4) are committed. (2) 2329ba3: the Designer copies package_sources into envelope/execution_permission.json as the profile lists them, and carries an intake's held[] into the synthesis's and the specification's held[] as it is (the spec is then held). Beyond the ask, as for v8: a first build or a rebuild of a network tool that opens by the permission and names no installs_from, or a pair the permission does not list, is stopped writing nothing, since your B9 would refuse the bundle; A5's gate sentence names the source an install tool fetches from. (3) 13f9b25: template v9, LATEST, changes src/gate.py, CLAUDE.md, .claude/settings.json and TEMPLATE.json. A tool that reaches the network runs only where its contract names installs_from, its gate opens by the permission, and the permission reaches engine or instrument and lists the pair; every other network tool is refused, refused_by_safety, code GATE-NETWORK-001, whatever its contract asks of the gate (required false included, and one gated by safety values even with them set). A listed install at a level below engine is GATE-PERMISSION-001 naming the level, as in v8. CLAUDE.md says the install is the one network call and the does-not-do line excepts it; settings.json now denies a session's Edit and Write of envelope/execution_permission.json, which v8 left out. Tests: test_template_v9 runs the runner of a copy of v9 on an install stand-in (it fetches nothing) beside an engine stand-in that starts a process, with one and two listed pairs, none listed, sandbox, and no file; test_designer builds the echo request as an engine, a writer of files and a pixi install on lab-kyu-softmatter, each checked by validate.py --strict on the scratch tree, which fails B9 once the pair is removed from the copy. (4) 780b98c: goal.signature_of names the tool by registry_id where the goal gives one, its name otherwise; every goal here has registry_id null, so no recall here changes; tests on an engine (hoomd_blue in cases/) and an instrument (sma_microscope in the fixtures' store), asking whether the tool field matched, since by name the instrument case still meets on its other fields.
